description: Appuis aériens ENEDIS utilisés dans le cadre du déploiement de la Fibre sur le RIP de la Dordogne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte Périgord Numérique. These are the ENEDIS air support used for the deployment of the Fibre on the Dordogne RIP These data are taken from the database Gr@ceTHD V3 of 01/12/23. The structure of the “Technical Point” class has been retained to which the geometry from the class “Node” has been added. Coverage: Syndicat Mixte Périgord Numérique. The portal shows the English title as "ENEDIS air support used for the deployment of the Fibre on the Dordogne RIP" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte Périgord Numérique. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-01-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
